notes.title: hotfix! macOS input issue
notes.content: fixed an issue caused by the latest macOS updates that made it so you couldn't click anything

notes.title: hotfix! time travel bug
notes.content: the issue that caused some players to skip seasons on relaunching the game should be resolved! :o)

notes.title: hotfix! performance issues
notes.content: performance issues should be reduced on both windows and mac! :o)

notes.title: updates for 7/11/2022
notes.content:
[list]
[*]added mute music button to the main menu.
[*]added version number to options menu.
[*]added snails reward amount to achievements menu.
[*]increased the speed of picking a large amount of crops.
[*]increased the amount of peas earned from the seasonal income skills.
[*]fixed bug that gave more snails than intended for achievements.
[*]fixed bug w/ fullscreen when using multiple monitors.
[*]fixed bug that advanced multiple days at a time (hopefully!).
[*]fixed timer lengths not visually updating when setting custom times.
[*]fixed screen tearing in full-screen.
[/list]

notes.title: updates for 7/7/2022
notes.content:
[list]
[*]fixed sprite layering issue for bird and mailbox notification
[*]fixed mac resolution bug
[*]added info panel for what happens at the end of a season
[*]fixed bug related to unlocking the unique days achievements
[/list]
